bullets.text: GCC officials reported that a 40-day awareness drive successfully boosted waste segregation across south Chennai households.
The office should monitor further corporation reports on the campaign to sustain improved waste management practices.
Revenue authorities and police removed highway encroachments in Gummidipoondi bazaar under heavy security.
Avadi Central Crime Branch arrested a couple for swindling 7.16 crore rupees using forged mortgage documents.
Thousands of devotees waited three hours for darshan during the Purattasi Krithigai festival at the Thiruttani Murugan temple.
An EY and CII report estimates Coimbatore could scale its global capability center ecosystem to nearly 200 by 2032.
The office should watch for policy initiatives that support the growth of global capability centers in Coimbatore.
